GD1.title: attempt_owner_manifest drops null-shadowed/contradictory nested identities and intent/launch runner_identity
GD1.repair: collect_record now collects EVERY readable identity field independently (item-with-start, identity_at_start, identity, start_identity; outer pid from pid or census leader_pid); a present null/malformed field never shadows another (malformed recorded as unknown); >=2 distinct readable (pid,start) at one item record 'contradictory readable identities' and all are added via add() (which retains outer/nested PID contradictions as two identities); collect_record is applied to EVERY readable intent/launch/nolaunch/settlement/QUARANTINE record as well as summary/closeout, so an emitted runner_identity is retained without any launch-record/summary/closeout runner publication.
independent_test_oracles: t_nested_identity_without_outer_pid (outer/nested contradiction + omission of every identity)
t_allocation_release (complete/legacy scenarios with intent runner identities)
GD1.residual_or_conditional: Parent certification semantics unchanged (exact (pid,start) keys). Manifest 'unknowns' remain informational except publication_unknowns; parent must review them.

GD2.title: legacy_audit bypasses explicit disposal of a missing CURRENT closeout
GD2.repair: LEGACY_NO_CLOSEOUT_LAUNCH_SCHEMAS = {PILOT-LAUNCH-v14, PILOT-LAUNCH-v32, PSTREAM-LAUNCH-v4} (verified by source: those runners never write closeout.json). release_refusals adds publication unknown 'mandatory current closeout publication absent' unless the BOUND launch bytes parse with a proven-legacy schema, and passes closeout_legacy_proven to disposition_refusals; there a missing closeout is admissible by legacy_audit ONLY when legacy is proven, otherwise ONLY by explicit publication_failure_disposed=True (audited release, never qualification).
independent_test_oracles: t_allocation_release: refused current_missing_closeout_with_bare_legacy_flag, unbound_legacy_launch_missing_closeout_with_legacy_flag; admitted twin current_missing_closeout_after_explicit_failure_disposition; legacy_after_explicit_parent_audit retained
GD2.residual_or_conditional: Legacy proof relies on the bound launch schema string; parent audit of legacy attempts remains required.

GD3.title: raw read/traversal descriptors outside the acquisition inventory
GD3.repair: Every raw acquisition is registered in RAW_FDS BEFORE the syscall; OSError proves not_acquired, any other exception leaves acquisition_uncertain; the observed {dev,ino,kind} (or explicit unavailable) is retained before any caller inspection; each acquired number gets exactly one owning close (raw_close) whose exception leaves close_uncertain (never retried); open_regular returns (fd, st, record) and accepts a pre-registered record so verify_sat/rehash TRANSFER the single record (no duplicate owner). unresolved_inventory reports every record unless coherently resolved (not_acquired without evidence; closed with one returned close; anchored only while TREE owns exactly fd+observed dev/ino). create_excl records its rollback close outcome.
independent_test_oracles: t_raw_read_walk_acquisition_inventory (registration-before-inspection, rollback/owning close uncertainty, OSError vs unknown acquisition, walk root/child, reuse sentinel)
t_raw_descriptor_ownership_contract (coherent/incoherent states incl. orphan anchor; anchor_dir; verify_sat transfer)
GD3.residual_or_conditional: CPython-internal descriptors (os.scandir streams, subprocess pipes, file-object internals) remain outside RAW_FDS by design; RAW_FDS grows append-only per acquisition (bounded by run work caps).

GD4.title: helper cancellation masks settlement-only safety defects
GD4.repair: _settle computes settlement_safety (native drift; exit observed beyond HELPER_WALL; settlement beyond HELPER_ALLOW; frozen abs/mono cutoffs) BEFORE classification and records it; cancellation-only HelperRefused requires stop==owner_cancel_sigterm, trips==['owner_cancel_sigterm'] AND no settlement safety; otherwise latch + RuntimeError. Single identity-checked SIGTERM path unchanged.
independent_test_oracles: t_helper_cancel_safety_precedence: cancel_with_settlement_only_drift, cancel_with_settlement_only_late_exit (RuntimeError, latch, one stop request) plus original cancel-only/safety cases
GD4.residual_or_conditional: clock() still converts RuntimeError into a latched 'required host clock failed' (unchanged).

GD5.title: publication success outlives its original operation allowance
GD5.repair: write_bytes_x fences the digest and success boundary against the ORIGINAL `end` before register_written/publication_complete (late => failed publication, publication_complete False). commit_record runs post-publication cutoff/confinement/preservation under STATE cleanup_deadline=min(prior,end) and appends a completion defect when completion is observed beyond `end`; the record returns original_operation_allowance_mono and the observed done time.
independent_test_oracles: t_commit_publication_original_allowance: timely twin commits; late post-publication preservation never commits and latches
GD5.residual_or_conditional: Global cutoffs still checked separately; OS call latency is not bounded (documented).

I1-1.title: D35 sink_integrity ignores observed transport evidence
I1-1.repair: Producer schema: explicit reader/unblock/rehash *_fd_acquired booleans, retained fifo_identity, observed {dev,ino,kind} per endpoint and the single rehash RAW_FDS record in finish/accounting/late_obligations. Consumer: sink_integrity requires reader acquired+observed == retained FIFO, unblock either acquired+observed FIFO+unblocked_by_runner or explicitly never acquired (no number/observation/unblock), rehash acquired+observed == retained file and a coherent closed record whose fd/observation match; buffer_integrity (P) applies the same FIFO endpoint schema. Missing, unavailable, numeric, truthy or contradictory observations refuse while the receipt retains them.
independent_test_oracles: t_d2_qualification_matrix observed-schema rows (+ corrected coherent one-valued twins)
I1-1.residual_or_conditional: Real producer behaviour (actual fstat values) needs runtime controls under separate GO.

I1-2.title: verify_sat read/check/close without original-deadline fence
I1-2.repair: verify_sat(cnf_path, kissat_lines, label, cnf_limit, deadline=None): exact int byte bound required; ONE allowance fixed before acquisition; acquisition fence and st_size refusal with one raw close; bounded readline loop with progress/completion fences and growth refusal; wrapper transfer of the single record; the owned close always runs; read/check/close completion fenced BEFORE candidate publication. run_plan passes it['cnf'][1].
independent_test_oracles: t_verify_sat_original_deadline (late acquisition, oversize, late read, growth, late close: one close, no publication; timely twin publishes)
I1-2.residual_or_conditional: Controls-only branch cannot reach verify_sat (ITEMS=[]); latent path only.

I2-1.title: Feeder records descriptor numbers as transport identities
I2-1.repair: Feeder fstat's each pipe endpoint right after os.pipe and retains read/write_endpoint_observed_identity {dev,ino,kind} (or explicit unavailable, which refuses construction after one close per endpoint); *_endpoint_identity documented as NUMBER history only; observations exported in finish/accounting/late_obligations; FEED_STATE and C7b require acquired endpoints with exact typed FIFO observations.
independent_test_oracles: t_transport_close_fault_identity (observations survive uncertain closes in all interfaces; unavailable observation)
I2-1.residual_or_conditional: Pipe inode numbers are recyclable on macOS; observations distinguish objects at disposal time only together with the retained history.

I2-2.title: D35 rehash close not fenced before success/registration
I2-2.repair: _rehash_file holds the result, performs the ONE raw_close, mirrors the record, refuses uncertain close, then checks the UNCHANGED end before returning; finish() rechecks end immediately before register_written; late/uncertain completion skips registration without another close/hash or renewed allowance.
independent_test_oracles: t_d2_rehash_close_registration_fence (timely/late/uncertain close; registration crossing; endpoint checker negatives)

T1-1.title: fixture failures lose descriptor ownership evidence
T1-1.repair: Test-owned raw descriptors are registered before os.open (fixture_open: OSError not_acquired, otherwise acquisition_uncertain) and closed at most once via fixture_close; run_filter/scripted_filter register the capture file before creation, close it at most once while fixture-owned, retain it UNKNOWN after an ambiguous reader start and record the reader's single close.
independent_test_oracles: t_fixture_fd_handoff_ownership: fifo_writer close/close-failure, run_filter capture closed once / ambiguous retained
T1-1.residual_or_conditional: Python-managed 'with open' fixture file creations elsewhere are unchanged (not raw descriptors).

T1-2.title: admission pins miss mutable native observation functions
T1-2.repair: Pins add native_members (os.waitid/waitpid/read/close/fstat/getpid, signal.getsignal, time.monotonic/time/sleep, select.select, Popen.__init__/_execute_child, LIBPROC functions), more functions (bsd_identity, task_rss, list_pids, _pidinfo, descendants, parse_pid_buffer, deadline_check) and constructor/method pins (Owned._owned_init/remember_identity/known_pids/_identity_uncertain, Helper.__init__); the refusal oracle mutates eight members independently.
T1-2.residual_or_conditional: Pins are identity checks in-process only.

T1-3.title: initial receipt publication lacks failure disposition
T1-3.repair: publish_json_x is a raw exclusive publication retaining an attempt record (creation/write/fsync/close states; simultaneous operation and close errors); main guards the receipt publication: failure prints the retained attempt evidence and returns 71 (never resolution proof); result/completion failures print evidence too; the receipt digest is carried into result.json.
independent_test_oracles: t_receipt_publication_failure_disposition (isolated main: 71, evidence printed, no runner load)
T1-3.residual_or_conditional: Parent must treat 71 as unresolved publication evidence.

T1-4.repair: Pre-existing inert sentinels (R.STATE entry and R.HELPER_LOG member) must have disjoint proxy counterparts; only counterparts are mutated; originals verified by canonical snapshots; registries compared with explicit structural snapshots (no repr); sentinels removed by identity.

T2-1.title: malformed endpoint fingerprints license unproved feeder closure
T2-1.repair: Fingerprints must be exact [dev, ino, mode] non-bool ints of a FIFO and bound to the producer's observed endpoint identities before reuse reasoning; malformed => unknown ownership: only EBADF on every number avoids refusal; nothing is closed.
independent_test_oracles: t_feeder_fingerprint_schema_refusals (real open pipe: empty/float/bool/non-FIFO/unbound/bound-open refuse; bound-after-close admitted)

T2-3.title: disposition filtering discards contradictory runner identity
T2-3.repair: Dispositions bind the authoritative runner identity (sha-bound); licensing requires equal (pid,start) in top-level or nested form; contradictory, malformed, self-contradictory or absent identity is never licensed.

T2-4.title: unavailable descriptor observations counted as closure
T2-4.repair: Only EBADF is closure evidence; other inspection errors are explicit uncertainty; negative EIO case.

T2-5.title: descriptor resolution erases acquisition uncertainty/contradictory history
T2-5.repair: fixture_dup: OSError not_acquired else acquisition_uncertain; inventories resolve only coherent histories; terminal raw inspection requires coherent histories and identity-bound anchors; handoff oracle covers acquisition exceptions, registry-before-return and pipe_writer closure.

T3-1.title: corruption fixture loses raw-descriptor ownership
T3-1.repair: Corruption and replacement descriptors registered via fixture_open with observed identity, closed once via fixture_close; restoration requires proven closure.

T3-2.title: endpoint checker accepts missing acquisition history
T3-2.repair: Checker takes the scenario's expected acquisitions as an independent ledger (flags, numbers, available observations; unexpected endpoints must show non-acquisition), requires the writer's registry record, EBADF-only closure; replacement rehash observation compared with the independently captured replacement fingerprint; unavailable-fstat negatives.

T3-3.title: raw-inventory oracle excludes an orphaned anchor
T3-3.repair: Production treats 'anchored' as resolved only when TREE owns the exact fd+observed identity; the oracle now expects the orphan (and incoherent resolved-looking records) in the production unresolved set.

T3-4.title: acquisition-before-allowance ordering untested
T3-4.repair: Acquisition crossing the original allowance and a late successful nonempty read refuse with exactly one close and no further reads; production adds explicit post-acquisition fences.

T3-5.title: nested-identity coverage omits contradiction branch
T3-5.repair: Valid outer/nested PID disagreement retains both identities with explicit uncertainty; independent omission of EVERY identity (including both summary-derived) refuses.
